g.text: (a) Estimates (gray) and posterior means (blue) with 95% intervals; the vertical line is the mean effect's posterior mean. (b)
Posterior mean site reliabilities with 95% intervals; lines: informativeness I and mean reliability. (c) Posterior density of I:
solid line, posterior mean; dashed, the value at the posterior mean of sigma_tau^2. The density grows without bound near I = 0,
and its vertical axis is cut there. (d) Informativeness and logit variance, with contours of the leading term of H, I (1 - I) V /
2, at 0.01, 0.02, 0.03, 0.04. Posterior summaries, conditional on the supplied standard errors.
